December 13, 2.

Dear Saint Oyant,

I forward herewith for your information tabulated
statements relating to three prisoners named Woo Lan Ding
(吳蘭亭) alias Woo Ts Tsung (吳士貞), Tseu Tong Hai
(周通海) and Tsoong Chiu Lien (鍾秋蓮) alias Tseong Lien
(鍾廉), who were arrested by Settlement Police at about
9 p.m. on October 25, 1932, outside the Doong Loh Teashop,
1877 Ying Hwa Li, Robison Road, where, prior to the arrival
of the Police, they had been holding a communist meeting.

The three accused appeared on remand before the 2nd
Branch Kiangsu High Court on December 9, when they were
ordered to be handed over to the Chinese Authorities.

Attached are lists of the communist literature seized
at the homes of the 1st and 3rd accused.

Yours sincerely,

Sub '¾
JJS

Inspector E. Saint Oyant,
Chief of the Political Section,
Shanghai Police Headquarters.

12月13日，2点。

亲爱的圣奥扬特（Saint Oyant）：

现随函附上关于三名囚犯的表格陈述，供你方参考。这三名囚犯名为吴兰亭（Woo Lan Ding），化名吴士贞（Woo Ts Tsung）；周通海（Tseu Tong Hai）；以及钟秋莲（Tsoong Chiu Lien），化名钟廉（Tseong Lien）。他们于1932年10月25日晚9点左右，在罗宾逊路（Robison Road）英华里1877号同乐茶楼（Doong Loh Teashop）外被租界警察逮捕。在警察到达之前，他们正在该处举行共产党会议。

这三名被告于12月9日在江苏高等法院第二分院出庭受审，当时法庭命令将他们移交给中国当局。

附件为在第一和第三名被告家中搜获的共产党文献清单。

此致，

副督察 [签名不清]
JJS

E. 圣奥扬特（E. Saint Oyant）督察，
政治部主任，
上海警察总局。

Proceedings
Mr. Lea appeared for the police.
Mr. Tseu Kyl Vung appeared for the I.S. Bureau.

Mr. Tseu:-These accused were implicated by others already in the custody of the I.S. Bureau. They do not want to reveal the names of those who implicated them, as they want to keep them secret, because they are expecting to affect another arrest.
Judge:-This Court has received no official document from the S.P. S. Bureau.
police
Mr. Tseu:-I have given an official letter to the XXXX Advocate.
Mr. Lea :-Since the S.P.S. Bureau have not filed the official documents, I ask the Court to remand the case till next Wednesday.
Mr. Tseu:-I ask the Court to hand the accused over today, and there will be an official document in Court before 5pm. today.
Mr. Lea:-The police will then have no objection to the accused being handed over to them, because when they were arrested, communist literature was found in the house.

All accused to be handed over to the S.P.S. Bureau together with the seized documents and property.

第二名被告：- 1931年9月2日[注：原文为31年，但其他文件多为32年，此处照实翻译]，我在兰道（landao，地名不清，音译）被上海警察局逮捕，后来获释。这次茶馆里没有开会。我去那里是谈生意。我不认识第三名被告，但他确实和我们坐在同一张桌子旁。

第三名被告：- 几天前我遇到第一名被告，他让我昨天在这家茶馆见他。当我到达时，第一名和第二名被告已经在那里了。

证人盛先生（Mr. Shing）：- 我代表公安局：- 根据情报，昨天这家茶馆将举行共产党会议，我与局里其他人一起前往苏州路（Soctoo Road，即Suzhou Road）警署寻求协助以逮捕这些被告。我现在没有带公文。我将在下次听证时出示。

傅先生（Mr. Foo）：- 由于被告均在租界内被捕，如果公安局希望移交他们，其代表必须首先提供证据，证明他们涉及在中国领土内的任何犯罪行为。

判决。    所有被告予以拘留。

W.K.W.

Zung先生

Extract of Daily Intelligence Report dated 24.10.32

Communist Propaganda - three arrests

At 8.50 p.m. October 23, acting on information received
from the Chinese Authorities to the effect that a meeting was
being held by six communist suspects in the Doon; Loh (同樂)
Teashop, No.1877 Ying Hwa Li, Robison Road, the Municipal
Police visited the teashop but found that the gathering
had already dispersed. However, the following three persons
reported to have been present at the meeting were subsequently
arrested on Robison Road outside the teashop :-

1. Woo Lan Ding (吳蘭亭), alias Woo Ts Tsung (吳子宗),
age 32, Hupeh, living at No.3442 Robison Road.

2. Tseu Tong Hai (周通海), age 21, Kempo, living in a
straw hut off Macao Road.

3. Tsong Chiu Yien (鐘秋炎), alias Tsong Lien(鐘廉),
age 25, Hunan, living at No.7 South Chengtu Road.

A search of the dwellings of the 1st and 3rd accused
resulted in the seizure of a quantity of communist and
pro-communist literature in Chinese and Japanese, but nothing
was found at the home of the 2nd accused. The accused will
be brought before Court on October 24 when an application
for their extradition to the Chinese Authorities will be
made.

共产主义宣传 - 三人被捕

10月23日晚8点50分，根据从中国当局收到的情报，称有六名共产党嫌疑人在罗宾逊路（Robison Road）英华里1877号同乐（Doon; Loh）茶馆举行会议，工部局警察前往该茶馆，但发现聚会已经解散。然而，据报道出席该会议的以下三人随后在茶馆外的罗宾逊路上被捕：-

1. 吴兰亭（Woo Lan Ding），化名吴子宗（Woo Ts Tsung），32岁，湖北人，居住在罗宾逊路3442号。

2. 周通海（Tseu Tong Hai），21岁，金波（Kempo，地名不清，音译）人，居住在澳门路旁的一间草屋里。

3. 钟秋炎（Tsong Chiu Yien），化名钟廉（Tsong Lien），25岁，湖南人，居住在成都南路7号。

对第一和第三名被告住所的搜查结果缴获了大量中文和日文的共产主义及亲共产主义文献，但在第二名被告家中未发现任何物品。被告将于10月24日被带上法庭，届时将申请将其引渡给中国当局。

The following is the statement of Tsoong Chiu Yien.
native of Hunan taken by me C.D.3.283.
at P.Rd.Station. on the 23.10.32. and interpreted by Chang Wen Ta.

My name is Tsoong Chiu Yien, alias Tsoong Lien, I am native of
Dau Yuan Hsien of Hunan Province, unemployed, and living in a
room above the kitchen, No.7 Foo Zung Lee Alleyway, off Chengtu
Road. I am employed by the Chung Hwa Printing Works, Pakhoi Road,
as a coolie. At 7 p.m. to-day I went to the Doong Loh Teashop
Robison Road for the purpose of visiting my friend Woo Lan Ding
whom I knew since 3 or 4 years ago at Hankow. A few days ago
when I was on the way to the Orpheum Theatre, I met Woo Lan Ding
on the Robison Road, where he asked me to meet him to-day at the
Doong Loh Teashop as he requested me to get him a job. Half an
hour after I had talked with Woo Lan Ding, I was arrested by the
Police at the downstairs of the teashop. I don't known the
another man arrested by the Police.

My name is Tsou Tong Hai, aged 21, I am a native of Kompo, employed at a building contractor's yard, Chapui, as a coolie and living in a straw hut on Macao Road. About 2 years ago I worked in the Doong Shing Cotton Mill together with Woo Lan Ding, since then I knew him. As Woo Lan Ding is out of work now, he requested me to do hawker business in company with him, but I think that he is not phisical strong enough to carry such a business. Learning that I have been planting vegetables, Woo Lan Ding asked me to meet him in the Doong Loh Teashop to discuss the vegetable business. At 8 p.m. today I went to the above teeshop to consulted with him about the hawker business, but I was arrested by the Police when I was stepping downstairs. I don't know anyone else.
